//! Subsystem build-tag registry for the tokenfold plugin loader (F-063 holdout slice).
use crate::plugin::registry::PluginId;
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Build metadata recorded for each subsystem at compile time.
pub struct SubsystemTag {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub build_tag: &'static str,
}

pub const SUBSYSTEM_TAGS: &[SubsystemTag] = &[
    SubsystemTag { name: "index-writer", build_tag: "bt-2f19-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "index-reader", build_tag: "bt-7a3c-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "query-planner", build_tag: "bt-11d4-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "query-executor", build_tag: "bt-88ab-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "cache-evictor", build_tag: "bt-33f0-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "cache-warmup", build_tag: "bt-90c2-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "wal-writer", build_tag: "bt-5566-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "wal-flush", build_tag: "bt-6e21-canary" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "wal-replay", build_tag: "bt-a10f-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "segment-merge", build_tag: "bt-9e40-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "segment-split", build_tag: "bt-c701-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "snapshot-export", build_tag: "bt-4b8d-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "snapshot-import", build_tag: "bt-fe22-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "replica-sync", build_tag: "bt-0a91-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "replica-catchup", build_tag: "bt-77cd-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "gc-sweeper", build_tag: "bt-e3f5-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "gc-compactor", build_tag: "bt-1290-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "metrics-emitter", build_tag: "bt-b64a-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "metrics-rollup", build_tag: "bt-d817-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "auth-gateway", build_tag: "bt-5c3e-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "auth-refresh", build_tag: "bt-2299-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "rate-limiter", build_tag: "bt-8f61-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "rate-reporter", build_tag: "bt-46ab-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "schema-loader", build_tag: "bt-cc02-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "schema-migrator", build_tag: "bt-7710-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "batch-scheduler", build_tag: "bt-af33-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "batch-runner", build_tag: "bt-1d4e-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "config-loader", build_tag: "bt-9902-stable" },
    SubsystemTag { name: "config-watcher", build_tag: "bt-3e6f-stable" },
];

impl SubsystemTag {
    /// Look up a subsystem's build tag by name.
    pub fn find(name: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
        SUBSYSTEM_TAGS.iter().find(|t| t.name == name).map(|t| t.build_tag)
    }
}
query: In the plugin loader's subsystem build-tag registry, what build_tag is recorded for the wal-flush subsystem?
notes: Lexical case: the query repeats 'wal-flush'/'build_tag' verbatim, which appear on the gold entry. At a tight budget the entry sits among 28 near-identical `SubsystemTag { name, build_tag }` rows with unique per-row names/tags, so raw term frequency stays flat and recency instead keeps only the last few rows (config-loader, config-watcher), missing the mid-array wal-flush row entirely; llmlingua_style also has no strong signal since every row shares the same struct-literal token shape except the rare 'canary' channel marker. The plugin-registry module path is on its own force-kept use line, separate from the gold row.
